thread:
Jordan (sales-eng): Customer POC in APAC hitting `404 model unavailable in region` when pinning model-redwood-2.1. Demo tomorrow, needs unblock.
Priya (solutions): Which exact model id + region and copy of error?
Jordan (sales-eng): region=ap-southeast-1. Error payload: `{"error":"model not found in region", "model":"model-redwood-2.1"}`. We tried model-redwood-2.1-quant and then saw intermittent 429s under burst.
Sam (eng-runtime): Two issues: 1) 2.1 full-precision wasn't deployed to APAC (upstream image deprecated). 2) 429s are burst throttling from their load pattern (many short sequential requests, no batching).
Jordan (sales-eng): They require exact-version pin for QA. Any safe workarounds to preserve pin behavior?
Sam (eng-runtime): Short-term option: create a scoped alias named model-redwood-2.1 that routes for that account to model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac. Preserves the pin semantics without exposing to other tenants. Needs infra+security signoff.
Maria (security): If we alias to quantized, confirm same model family and KMS usage. Need KMS key id and confirmation that weights weren't altered. Also require audit log retention (90d) for their compliance team.
Priya (solutions): Demo only needs functional parity. We can accept slight latency variance for now.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll open a canary deploy with 10% traffic scoped to their acct. Also temporarily raise rate-limit window for 30 minutes to avoid 429s during demo (note: increased billable cost).
Jordan (sales-eng): Please capture the KMS details and log export link so I can send to customer security.
Sam (eng-runtime): KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/abc-quant-kms-1951. No weight changes performed; alias is routing-only. Logs will be exported to s3://redwood-audit/poc-1951112223/ with 90d retention.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/alias-apac-1951112223 -> model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac (canary 10%)
Sam (eng-runtime): Canary looks healthy. Increasing rate window now.
deploy-bot: deploy success: alias-apac-1951112223 -> model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac (promoted to 100%). audit-log: https://audit.redwood.internal/logs/1951112223
Maria (security): Reviewed KMS and audit path, retention ok. Approving scoped alias for demo only. Require SOW note about temporary routing and rate bump.
Priya (solutions): Added SOW bullet: "Temporary alias routing to quantized APAC variant and transient rate-limit increase for demo; production to be scoped in follow-up (Dedicated/Private recommended)."
Jordan (sales-eng): Demo succeeded. Customer accepted the quantized alias for POC; security signed off with audit link. Marking resolved. Thanks everyone :tada:
